title: Evaluating Neural Word Embeddings for Sanskrit
reasoning: The paper evaluates word embedding models for the Sanskrit language using linguistic tasks. Although the corpus may contain religious texts (e.g., from Vedabase, Ramayanam, and Mahabharatam) and the language itself has religious significance, the evaluation framework does not assess religious, moral, or ethical concepts. The focus is purely on the technical performance of NLP models on linguistic phenomena like syntax and semantics.
